Moving beyond the adventurous spirit of the Burberry Her EDP, the scent is the latest chapter in the intensifying story of Burberry Her. Designed for women who dare to explore the unknown, Her Elixir de Parfum is for the free-spirited woman seeking the excitement of her next adventure. Sensual, irresistible and not held back by boundaries, she possesses an addictive persona. Her Elixir de Parfum for women offers signature fruity gourmand notes alongside a daring burst of dark red berries with jasmine, rounded with sensual and addictive vanilla and amber. Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum deepens the pink of the EDP bottle, transforming it into an opaque finish representing the intensity of the fragrance inside and its confident and sensual nature.

sources.name: Burberry Her Elixir de Parfum for Women 100ml

results.name: Marc Jacobs Daisy EDT 50ml
results.description: Daisy captivates with the luscious freshness of wild strawberry, then blooms with the modern vintage edge of velvety violet petals and finishes with a luminous blend of gardenia and jasmine. The white accords of birch and cedarwood add a bit of intensity.

results.name: Yves Saint Laurent Opium EDT Spray 90ml
results.description: The opulent decadence of the Eau de Parfum captures the overtly sensual spirit of the original parfum designed by Yves Saint Laurent only in a lighter spray form. Striking notes of mandarin and bergamot are made mystical with middle notes myrrh and jasmine. A final accord of deep amber laced with Opoponaux imbues the scent with its celebrated rapture. In a chic Chinoiserie-inspired flacon.

results.name: Billie Eilish EDP 30ml
results.description: Eilish Eau de Parfum is a sensual and sweet fragrance that wraps the skin in a blend of sugared petals, creamy vanilla, and soft woods. Designed to feel like a second skin, it opens with delicate hints of red berries and mandarin, leading into a heart of vanilla, cocoa, and spices, grounded by warm amber and musk. It’s intimate, addictive, and uniquely Billie.

results.name: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 60ml
results.description: "I Want Choo Le Parfum" embodies the bold, glamorous, and exceptional craftsmanship synonymous with Jimmy Choo. ‘I Want Choo Le Parfum’ is a playful, vibrant ode to empowering female friendships, evoking glamorous and memorable nights. This amber floral woody fragrance opens with vibrant notes of pear and is adorned by the solar inflection of golden gardenia. The middle notes combine a creamy, warm heart with sweet jasmine, irresistible patchouli, and ambrette. The glamorous base notes, blending with moss, amber, sandalwood, and praline accord, give the creation a long-lasting trail. The sculptural-shaped bottle, crafted from captivating translucent gold metallic glass, is embellished with the distinctive JC monogram. Its gold spray cap and accent ring, intricately hammered with the iconic Jimmy Choo signature, add the finishing touches to the bottle's design. This exquisite bottle is complemented by sparkling gold outer packaging. Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum embodies a spirit of playfulness, combined with glamour, empowerment, and ignited confidence.

sources.name: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 60ml

results.name: Versace Dylan Turquoise EDT 50ml
results.description: Sensual, young and fresh, the new Dylan Turquoise fragrance balances the effervescent exuberance of zesty mandarin and primofiore lemon with hints of wood and musk. The vibrant notes are complemented with fruity accents of blackcurrant and guava, as well as jasmine and freesia floral tones. A twist on brand heritage,, the elegant bottle has curved lines reminiscent of a Greek amphora, refreshed in a crystalline turquoise tone.

results.name: Coach Gold Parfum 50ml
results.description: Coach Gold is inspired by sun-drenched brillance and an invitation to unlock your inner glow. THE FRAGRANCE Shimmering with sparkling pink peppercorn, the radiant parfum pairs the sensuality of vanilla notes with a comforting almond blossom accord, leaving an addictive trail of golden amber. THE DESIGN The bottle features an intense and slightly transparent gold lacquering. An iconic “C” charm is accompanied by an iridescent hangtag, a nod to the quality of Coach craftsmanship. Featuring Coach’s iconic Horse and Carriage logo, the outer pack has a textured gold effect to give some preciousness to this parfum. THE CAMPAIGN The american actress Storm Reid embodies the luminous scent of Coach Gold. Energized by this fragrance and the warmth of the sun, Storm finds the courage to express her vibrant personality and unlock her inner glow.

sources.name: Coach Gold Parfum 50ml

results.name: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Gold Extrait EDP 30ml
results.description: HAPPINESS IS THE MOST PRECIOUS GIFT Overflowing with mystery, radiating happiness: Our first Woody Iris was created, exclusively for Lancome, by two eminent French perfumers. Our most opulent interpretation of happiness our signature iris heightened by oud wood accord a new precious golden bottle WHAT MAKES THE DIFFERENCE La Vie Est Belle L'Extrait's scent is a sophisticated and sensual reinterpretation of our Iconic Eau de Parfum. The voluptuous floral heart of Damascena Rose blends with our signature Iris Pallida. A powerful, yet delicate duet, heightened by the depth of the Oud Wood Accord. This exquisite scent is captured in a reinvented bottle, our crystal smile now dipped in gold. WHAT ELSE YOU NEED TO KNOW La Vie Est Belle L'Extrait is an invitation to find happiness. Chase it, while following your dreams and cherish it at every fleeting moment. Shape your path to happiness and experience it your own way. Life is what you make of it. Make it beautiful.

results.name: Emporio Armani Power of You EDP 30ml
results.description: As the fragrance opens, it unveils the vibrant, captivating maracuja-passion fruit accord, evoking the fruit's purest essence. At the very heart of the composition, the fragrance finds its radiant soul, a transparent frangipani accord reverberates through the fragrance. A profound, sensual depth then emerges. Creamy, addictive vanilla absolute from Madagascar, is beautifully woven with the nuanced, caramel-like sweetness of benzoin resinoid. More than a scent, a fragrance that instantly owns the space of its radiant halo, inspiring others to embrace their own power to light up the room. Power of You, a day to night Exotic Radiance.

results.name: Chloe Eau de Parfum 30ml
results.description:
Chloé Eau de Parfum captures the spirit of the modern, confident woman with a fragrance that is both fresh and sophisticated. Light yet distinctive, this iconic scent reimagines the classic rose with a modern twist, creating a floral perfume that feels airy, luminous, and effortlessly elegant.

The fragrance opens with delicate top notes of peony, litchi, and freesia, offering a soft and refreshing introduction. At its heart lies the signature rose accord, beautifully balanced with lily of the valley and magnolia for a romantic floral bouquet. The scent finishes with warm base notes of amber and Virginia cedar, adding depth and long lasting elegance.

Presented in Chloé’s signature pleated glass bottle with a hand tied ribbon, this Eau de Parfum reflects the brand’s timeless Parisian style. Perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions, the 30ml size is ideal for carrying in your handbag so your favourite scent is always within reach.

Key Benefits

• Elegant floral fragrance with a modern rose signature
• Top notes of peony, litchi, and freesia
• Heart notes of rose, magnolia, and lily of the valley
• Warm base notes of cedar and amber for lasting depth
• Compact 30ml bottle ideal for travel or everyday use

sources.name: Chloe Eau de Parfum 30ml
